what: The hammer from the SECOND ROW (kill check of drill T0-2 'side of the strike'; tmp/drill2/design_merged.md). Target: Skaven clanrats_1 (160, shields), its morale kept, ordered 30 m ('narrow') or 45 m ('wide') wide. Anvil: Empire spearmen_0 (30 m, fearless) 1.5 m off its front, both attack at a walk at the go. Hammer: Empire swordsmen (30 m, fearless), centre 30 m behind the anvil's centre. The order to the hammer 10 s after the target's first melee flag. Lanes: front = attack at a run; flank = run to P (35 m edge to edge off the target's flank, facing it), attack within 8 m of P or after 30 s; cfront / cteach / cforced = the same as front / flank with cancel / flank, and a second clanrats (centre 60 m beyond P) attacks the hammer at a run 4 s after the order; cteach cancels the walk for good (attacks the target directly) when that unit comes within 40 m of the way left. trade = target lost - (anvil + hammer) lost, shares of start health, over [order, order + 120 s]. Normal difficulty, flat field, 5 lanes a battle 400+ m apart, 16 battles a width, mirrored by battle. side = the target's contact list side of the hammer from memory (memreader).
paired_why: [mean, SE = sd of the battle differences / sqrt(n), n]; twin = the simulator (commit 92c5919 + the probe's commit 2d97608) on the recorded starts, 8 copies a battle

verdict.open flank: GO: pooled flank - front +0.092, mean - 2SE +0.078 >= +0.03; each width's lower bound >= 0 (narrow +0.073, wide +0.070); contact side flank 31 of 32
verdict.cancel on a comer: OUT: cteach - cforced -0.047 narrow, -0.041 wide, both upper bounds below 0 - going on with the flank is better than cancelling
verdict.closing: PASS: cforced - cfront pooled +0.003, mean - 2SE -0.017 >= -0.03 (narrow +0.022, wide -0.016)
verdict.simulator: understates the open flank (narrow +0.039 against +0.096) and doubles the forced hammer's cost (cforced - cfront -0.179 / -0.239 against +0.022 / -0.016): a gross error, the sign of 'cancel or go on' is reversed
